title: Clang-tidy moves behind existing FeatureModule hooks
desc: Tidy responsibilities move with their original comments. Core parsing orchestration stays in place; matching remains a direct MatchFinder call.

title: Configuration and compiler warning options
desc: Only tidy options and warning handling move into the listener; frontend startup stays in ParsedAST. Action, MainInput, BeginSourceFile and the beforeBeginSourceFile hook loop remain unchanged. Use clangd's remapped main-file spelling; normalize only a relative fallback before configuration lookup.

title: Per-build state and ClangTidyContext
desc: Stack-local tidy state becomes per-build listener state. Context outlives its checks and MatchFinder; matching is invoked directly after parsing.

notes: Options move into ClangTidyContext; member order preserves dependent lifetimes.
Preamble listeners remain inactive. No deferred-consumer state is introduced.

title: Factories, custom checks and callback registration
desc: Check setup moves into beforePPCallbacks(), after BeginSourceFile and before clangd captures callbacks for preamble replay. The registry here is ClangTidyModuleRegistry (check factories), not FeatureModuleRegistry. Custom-check registration, its mutex, fast-check filtering and PP/matcher registration are retained.

title: Diagnostic suppression and severity policy
desc: The tidy-specific level adjuster moves to sawDiagnostic(), which edits the assembled diagnostic. Retains clangd suppression, NOLINT, system-macro filtering and warnings-as-errors. The nonempty-check guard is preserved: without active checks, tidy suppression and promotion remain disabled.

With no active tidy checks, compiler-warning suppression and promotion remain unchanged.

title: Diagnostic names and source move out of StoreDiags
desc: The listener identifies tidy diagnostics; StoreDiags no longer receives a ClangTidyContext and preserves supplied metadata. Compiler diagnostics retain their Clang source and -W name. Flushing, compiler metadata fallback, generic finalizer dispatch and deduplication stay in StoreDiags.

notes: StoreDiags keeps compiler metadata fallback and generic finalizer dispatch.
The generic callback contract for location-less diagnostics is unchanged.

title: Message cleanup and tidy-specific tags
desc: Message cleanup and tidy tags move into finalizeDiagnostic(), after notes and fixes are assembled. Constructor errors get tidy metadata here because they precede check initialization. Cleanup still covers messages, notes and fixes; containment checks avoid duplicate tags.

rows.text: // clang-tidy bakes the name into diagnostic messages. Strip it out.
// It would be much nicer to make clang-tidy not do this.

notes: Message cleanup covers the diagnostic, its notes and fixes.
Fallback names handle constructor diagnostics; containment checks avoid duplicate tags.

title: Application wiring replaces the provider plumbing
desc: ClangdMain explicitly creates the tidy module only when EnableClangTidy is true. Server and ParseInputs retain their existing generic FeatureModules forwarding.

title: Module-owned provider snapshots
desc: A module owns the options provider. Each listener captures a shared snapshot, allowing later provider replacement. An empty provider disables new listeners. Existing listeners keep their captured provider. This ownership and synchronization code is new, not relocated from ParsedAST.

title: Check-mode timing swaps only tidy's provider
desc: Timing temporarily swaps only tidy's provider, leaving other modules active. Clang-tidy must be enabled; a missing module produces an error.

rows.text: // Keep all other modules active while varying only tidy's configuration.

// Provider now holds the original configuration; restore it on exit.

notes: Provider allocation and both swaps are outside the measured Time() block.
The local variable saves the original provider; scope exit restores it.

title: TestTU keeps the short test configuration
desc: Tests may still assign TU.ClangTidyProvider. build() wraps it in a local module; inputs() only forwards explicit modules. ClangTidyProvider and FeatureModules are mutually exclusive in TestTU::build(). Mixed-module tests and direct inputs() callers use an explicit module set. This is a deliberate test-helper boundary.
notes: TU.ClangTidyProvider is a build()-only convenience adapter.
Mixed modules and direct inputs() calls use an explicit set; TestTU.h is unchanged.

title: Server and LSP tests register a feature module
desc: Tests embedding the server replace the removed options field with an explicitly constructed tidy module. The existing test inputs and assertions are retained; only setup changes. The LSP fixture already supplies its FeatureModuleSet to the server.

Clang's typo-correction adjustment, include fixes, token collection and lifecycle dispatch remain in the core. Preamble.cpp and FeatureModule.h are unchanged; the existing lifecycle hooks are reused.

desc: The parent already contains the zero-check, warning-option, relative-input and consumer-initialization tests. The migration adapts their setup.

desc: Both build descriptions add the same ClangTidyFeatureModule.cpp source. No lit test is introduced by this commit.

Timing with ordinary clang-tidy disabled is no longer preserved.
